props.text: Nobody can price an implant case from a phone call. Here is what actually moves the number.
By the practice, on your behalf
All five come out of the consultation and the 3D scan.
One tooth, a span, or an entire arch. Four posts carrying an arch is usually more cost-effective than replacing each tooth individually.
How long they have been missing
Bone recedes where teeth are not loading it. Time gone is the biggest predictor of whether anything has to be rebuilt first.
Extractions, bone grafting, sinus work: separate procedures with their own healing time, and the usual reason two quotes are months and thousands apart.
A zirconia fixed prosthesis is not the same object as an acrylic one. What is being quoted matters as much as how many implants.
Surgery, restoration and the laboratory under one roof removes the margin each outside party adds, and the second set of appointments with it.
Second opinions on implant surgery are free here. Bring the plan and the scan, and you will get a straight read on what is in it.
The cheapest option on day one is rarely the cheapest option.
are the lowest number at the start, and not a long-term solution: they rest on gum tissue, they move, they need relining, and the bone underneath keeps receding because nothing is loading it.
sit in the middle. The denture clips onto implants, which stops the movement and puts load back into the bone.

are the highest number up front and the lowest maintenance afterwards: no relining, no adhesive, no nightly removal. Ask any practice quoting you what the ten-year cost looks like, not just the day-one one.

Most dental PPO plans are accepted. Coverage for implants is often limited, but limited is not nothing. The practice files the claims on your behalf and works the plan for every benefit it actually entitles you to.
Three lenders, for three different situations.
Monthly payment plans through partners the practice already works with. Apply directly with any of them.
Flexible monthly payment options for patients who qualify. Manage the treatment cost over a term instead of in one payment.
, at fair fixed rates. The longest term of the three.
Apply from a phone in minutes, choose the rate, term and payment that fit, and have funds sent to your account for a lower APR.
Why is there no price list on this page?
Because an honest one cannot exist. Two people missing the same tooth can need entirely different treatment depending on what the bone is doing. You get a real number after the scan, in writing.

Some plans offer limited coverage. The practice files claims on your behalf and works to get every benefit your plan entitles you to. Whether that is a large or small share depends entirely on the plan.
Can I finance the whole case?
In most cases yes, through CareCredit, Proceed Finance or LendingClub. Proceed Finance carries the longest terms of the three, up to 96 months.
Is a second opinion really free?
Yes, on implant surgery. If you have been quoted elsewhere, bring the plan and any imaging.

props.text: How Much Do Dental Implants Cost in Northern Virginia?
How much do dental implants cost in McLean and Alexandria?

The same factors set the price at the Tysons Corner office and on Duke Street: how many implants, whether bone or teeth need treatment first, and what goes on top. Your figure comes from your own scan at the consultation, and second opinions are free.
What does a full mouth of implants cost?
It depends on the implants per arch, any grafting, and whether the teeth are removable or fixed zirconia. It is priced at the consultation, once the scan has been read.
